**需要在最开始和最后kill掉业务，防止死循环未结束，集群卡：**

os.system('ps ux|grep while_yasql.sh|grep -v grep|awk \'{print $2}\'|xargs kill -9')    
  os.system('ps ux|grep yfs_sql.sh|grep -v grep|awk \'{print $2}\'|xargs kill -9')    
  os.system('ps ux|grep while_view_yfs_grc_resource_all_tmp.sh|grep -v grep|awk \'{print $2}\'|xargs kill -9')    
  os.system('ps ux|grep yasql|grep -v grep|awk \'{print $2}\'|xargs kill -9')
